settings.title: Settings
settings.resume: Resume last game at power on

settings_desc.file_server: Manage the card's files from a computer or phone on the same Wi-Fi network.
settings_desc.restart: Restarts Mosaik. Settings and favorites are already saved.
settings_desc.suspend_now: Turns the screen off and pauses the console: the power button wakes it up.
settings_desc.pad_test: Shows every button you press and the position of the sticks: useful to check that they work.
settings_desc.stick_cal: Use this if a stick does not return to the centre or does not reach the edge.
settings_desc.key_f1: What the F1 bar does during arcade and console games.
settings_desc.key_f2: What the F2 bar does during arcade and console games.
settings_desc.key_home: What the side HOME button does during arcade and console games.
settings_desc.volume: System volume, also used in games.
settings_desc.theme: Look of the launcher and the in-game menu.
settings_desc.variant: Theme color scheme, when it offers more than one.
settings_desc.language: Menu language. Also passed to the emulators.
settings_desc.grid_columns: How many covers to show on each library row. Auto uses the theme's default.
settings_desc.home_size: Size of the covers on the home screen, in carousel themes.
settings_desc.aspect: Original: the game's own proportions. Integer pixels: sharp image. Full screen: fills everything.
settings_desc.filter: Effects on the game picture, such as the lines of old screens (scanlines).
settings_desc.cpu: Power saving extends battery life, Performance helps heavier games (CPS3).
settings_desc.wifi_nets: Shows the available networks to connect to.
settings_desc.sleep: Turns the console off after a period without input, in the launcher.
settings_desc.suspend: Puts the console to sleep after a period without input, in the launcher. The power button wakes it.
settings_desc.resume: If the console is turned off during a game, it starts again from there.
settings_desc.clock: Set the date and time: they are kept by the console's clock even when it's off.
settings_desc.timezone: Your time zone: the time shown also follows daylight saving time.
settings_desc.device: Simulates the Smart Pro or Brick Pro screen on the Mac.
settings_desc.info: Space on the SD card and what uses it: games per emulator, images, saves, music.
settings_desc.duplicates: Game present in both FinalBurn Neo and MAME 2003+: show both or only one.
settings_desc.scrape: Downloads screenshots, titles and marquees from the internet; for consoles also the box, year, publisher, genre and players. Works with Wi-Fi connected.
settings_desc.clean_media: Deletes downloaded images of games that are no longer on the card.
settings_desc.update: Downloads and installs the new version over Wi-Fi. Your ROMs, saves and settings stay as they are.
settings_desc.channel: Stable: released versions. Development: test builds. Going back to Stable applies from the next stable version.
settings_desc.update_notify: Once a day, with Wi-Fi connected, checks GitHub for a new version and shows a notice on the home screen. Nothing is downloaded.
settings_desc.log_level: Records what happens in the Arcade/Logs folder, useful when reporting a problem. “Off” is fine for normal use.
settings_desc.bezel: A decorative frame around the game: the game's own if there is one, otherwise the default.
settings_desc.missing: Also show catalog games you don't have (main versions only, not clones).
settings_desc.genres: Rename genres, merge them or go back to the originals. A single game's genre is changed from its page (X, then X).
settings_desc.screensaver: After a while without input: your games' screenshots or a blank screen.
settings_desc.romcheck: Checks that no game is missing any file. The full check also reads the data and finds damaged files.
settings_desc.pads: The console controls are player 1, a Bluetooth or USB controller is player 2. With “player 1” you play alone with the external controller.
settings_desc.music: Background music from the files in the SD card's Music folder (MP3, OGG, FLAC). A skips to the next track.
settings_desc.led: Console lights effect: off, steady, breathing or pulse. They blink red when the battery is low.
settings_desc.led_color: Light colour; “Theme” uses the main colour of the chosen theme.
settings_desc.autosave_exit: When you leave to the menu, the game goes into the automatic save, and on the home screen you pick it up with “Resume”. Off: it is saved only when the console turns off or sleeps.
settings_desc.box_covers: For console games, show the box, if it was downloaded, instead of the screenshot.
settings_desc.speaker_rest: The hiss comes from the amplifier: off after 4 s without sound, back on at the next sound. A and B: two ways of switching it off, to compare.
settings_desc.reset_settings: Settings, lists and Wi-Fi networks go back to new. Games and saves stay.
settings_desc.erase_all: Erases games, saves, BIOS files, images and settings: the card goes back to freshly written.
settings_desc.support: A PayPal donation to help development.
